flow_ref: User story (not in a flow deck, OCMS has none)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/NoticeSearch/hook/useSearchParams.tsx (generic notice_no search), pages/Notice/hook/useStagePermissions.tsx, utils/models/Icourtmention.d.ts; ocmsadminapi api-authorization.properties. ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no mention outcome code
note: Sheet status: Demo paid (50% of 75%); demo_remark empty. The story asks the Court Processing Officer to search for notices in OCMS and record the mention outcome (DNATA, adjournment, withdrawal) to update the notice. Only a generic notice search exists. There is no screen, form, endpoint, enum or DB column for a mention outcome: DNATA/adjournment/withdrawal appear nowhere in the six repos except a UI message telling the officer to 'apply DNATA' (useStagePermissions.tsx:86) with no function behind it. The Icourtmention type (mention_outcome) is TypeScript only. The CAS endpoints (casUpdateCourtNotices, casGetPaymentStatus, plus-get-court-case-info, plus-payment-activation) do not carry a mention outcome and are not credited. No maintenance ticket changes the verdict (OCMS-SR-2026-021 is only a data patch of a court mention date, not used). Whether the Demo paid status is backed by code cannot be verified from the repo.
recommendation: Not claimable as built apart from the generic notice search counted as Sebagian. Recording a mention outcome does not exist in code.

steps.step: Officer opens the notice search in OCMS and searches for a notice by notice number
steps.detail: A generic notice search exists in the staff portal: the notice_no form value is read (useSearchParams.tsx:167) and added to the list of notices searched (useSearchParams.tsx:258). It is a generic search, not a screen dedicated to recording mention outcomes, so Sebagian. There is no outcome-related search criterion (the words dnata/adjourn/withdraw appear nowhere in the six repos except the message at useStagePermissions.tsx:86).

steps.step: Officer selects the notice and records a mention outcome (DNATA, adjournment, withdrawal)
steps.detail: Tried synonyms mention outcome, dnata, adjourn/adjournment, withdraw/withdrawal, discharge, hearing, postpone, acquit across all six repos (java, ts/tsx, properties, sql; ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi) in both UI and API layers. Only relevant hits: the UI message at useStagePermissions.tsx:86 telling the officer to 'apply DNATA' with no DNATA function behind it; the type Icourtmention.d.ts:1-33 (field mention_outcome) is TypeScript only and unused; /v1/courtmention is in api-authorization.properties:23 but there is no courtmention controller/entity in ocmsadminapi and the UI never calls it.

steps.step: OCMS updates the notice with the recorded mention outcome
steps.detail: No endpoint, service or column in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi stores a mention outcome on a notice.
